protocol.decision: every completed 1m bar; execution at the next bar open book
protocol.exit_path: low (loss, time and regime exits), then high (profit exits), then close of each held bar
protocol.profit_exit_fill: the lowest price in the bar range at which a profit exit fires, to within 1/4096 of a search step (steps of 2 bps from the low, at most 4000, then 12 halvings), so the high only when the exit first fires that close to it; the range is searched whenever the high is in profit, since the protection band lies below a hold gap
protocol.stress_fee: the multiple applies to the modeled fee, max(configured, public taker), in decimals
protocol.open_at_end: counted at its executable estimate in net_marked, which the verdict reads
protocol.book_model: modeled from each bar at the market tick: spread_bps, level_quote and levels per series
protocol.orders: market only, taker fee both legs, quote-billed
protocol.verdict_rule: DEMONSTRATED only on real holdout data: net > 0, net > random mean + 2 sd, doubled-stress net > 0. Synthetic fixtures: MECHANICS ONLY.
